assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production game UI trait ICON ONLY, single isolated pictogram. Flat smooth 2D warm cream/ivory silhouette (#EFE5CF), one extremely restrained muted beige secondary tone only, very thin dark brown edge. High-resolution smooth anti-aliased outline NOT pixel-art. Simple strong symbol legible when shown at 45 to 65 pixels. No light source or realistic material, no shiny metal, no 3D, no bevel, no dimensional bulging, no gloss, no bright highlights, no gold texture, no sticker white outline, no enclosing circle/disc/medallion/frame, no glow/shadow, no backdrop or checkerboard, no text or numerals. Transparent PNG with real alpha outside and in internal cutouts. Square canvas. Icon occupies central 72% of width or height with generous consistent margin. White/ivory body stays dominant, dark edge should be only hairline not thick black. Subject: one elegant very simple medieval sword diagonally rising from lower left to upper right, straight slender blade, simple crossguard, short wrapped-free straight handle, small rounded pommel. One single thin central blade division, no jewels or engraving, no extra weapons.
